html: #include "cache.h" #define MTIME_CHANGED 0x0001 #define CTIME_CHANGED 0x0002 #define OWNER_CHANGED 0x0004 #define MODE_CHANGED 0x0008 #define INODE_CHANGED 0x0010 #define DATA_CHANGED 0x0020 static int match_stat(struct cache_entry *ce, struct stat *st) { unsigned int changed = 0; if (ce->mtime.sec != (unsigned int)st->st_mtim.tv_sec || ce->mtime.nsec != (unsigned int)st->st_mtim.tv_nsec) changed |= MTIME_CHANGED; if (ce->ctime.sec != (unsigned int)st->st_ctim.tv_sec || ce->ctime.nsec != (unsigned int)st->st_ctim.tv_nsec) changed |= CTIME_CHANGED; if (ce->st_uid != (unsigned int)st->st_uid || ce->st_gid != (unsigned int)st->st_gid) changed |= OWNER_CHANGED; if (ce->st_mode != (unsigned int)st->st_mode) changed |= MODE_CHANGED; if (ce->st_dev != (unsigned int)st->st_dev || ce->st_ino != (unsigned int)st->st_ino) changed |= INODE_CHANGED; if (ce->st_size != (unsigned int)st->st_size) changed |= DATA_CHANGED; return changed; } static void show_differences(struct cache_entry *ce, struct stat *cur, void *old_contents, unsigned long long old_size) { static char cmd[1000]; FILE *f; snprintf(cmd, sizeof(cmd), "diff -u - %s", ce->name); f = popen(cmd, "w"); fwrite(old_contents, old_size, 1, f); pclose(f); } int main(int argc, char **argv) { int entries = read_cache(); int i; if (entries < 0) { perror("read_cache"); exit(1); } for (i = 0; i < entries; i++) { struct stat st; struct cache_entry *ce = active_cache[i]; int n, changed; unsigned int mode; unsigned long size; char type[20]; void *new; if (stat(ce->name, &st) < 0) { printf("%s: %s\n", ce->name, strerror(errno)); continue; } changed = match_stat(ce, &st); if (!changed) { printf("%s: ok\n", ce->name); continue; } printf("%.*s: ", ce->namelen, ce->name); for (n = 0; n < 20; n++) printf("%02x", ce->sha1[n]); printf("\n"); new = read_sha1_file(ce->sha1, type, &size); show_differences(ce, &st, new, size); free(new); } return 0; }

html: // test.h: the tests' harness. A test is `TEST(name) { ... }`; a file ends with // `TEST_MAIN(TEST_CASE(a), TEST_CASE(b), ...)`, which runs every case named, // in order, and prints the exact count: // // c/tests/test_arena.c: 12 tests passed // // A failure names its test and its line and ends that test (the rest still // run), and the run exits 1. There is no skip: a `TEST` left out of // `TEST_MAIN` is a static function nothing calls, which GCC's `-Wall -Werror` // refuses, and `c/build.shale` holds each file's printed count to its `TEST`s. // `TEST_ONLY=a,b` in the environment runs only the cases it names (a plant's // aimed tests, a tier's part of a file), each name one a case has. // // Test files that share a costly include (c/tests/ran.c, the interpreter) // are parts of one binary instead: each ends with `TEST_PART`, the binary // includes them all and ends with `TEST_PARTS_MAIN`, and it prints each // part's count in its own line, as that file alone would. #ifndef SHALE_TEST_H #define SHALE_TEST_H // `fork` and `waitpid`, for EXPECT_DIES; a test file includes test.h first. #ifndef _POSIX_C_SOURCE #define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L #endif #include <setjmp.h> #include <signal.h> #include <sys/prctl.h> #include <sys/wait.h> #include <unistd.h> #include "slice.h" typedef struct { Str name; void (*fn)(void); } TestCase; SLICE_TYPE(TestCases, const TestCase); typedef struct { jmp_buf back; Str current; size_t failed; // Set in a death test's child, where a failure exits rather than jumps. bool in_child; } TestState; // How a death test's child ends when an EXPECT inside its `stmt` fails. enum { TEST_CHILD_FAILED = 2 }; static inline TestState *test_state(void) { static TestState state; return &state; } // A table of literal strings a test loops over, counted by the compiler: // `Lits paths = LITS("a", "b/c");` is a Lits of 2, so a case added to the // list runs with no count to keep in step. The count sizes the loop over // the cases only. A count the test asserts (how many a call found, how // many lines it wrote) stays a literal number: one computed from the table // agrees with any table, so it would hold whatever the code did. SLICE_TYPE(Lits, const char *const); // cstr: a test's literals #define LITS(...) \ ((Lits){(const char *const[]){__VA_ARGS__}, \ sizeof((const char *const[]){__VA_ARGS__}) / sizeof(const char *)}) #define TEST(name) static void test_##name(void) #define TEST_CASE(name) {S(#name), test_##name} static inline void test_fail(const char *file, int line, Str what) { // cstr: __FILE__ TestState *t = test_state(); fprintf(stderr, "FAIL %.*s (%s:%d): %.*s\n", (int)t->current.len, t->current.ptr, file, line, (int)what.len, what.ptr); // A jump in a child would land in its copy of test_run and run the // file's other tests there; the child ends, and the parent reads why. if (t->in_child) _exit(TEST_CHILD_FAILED); longjmp(t->back, 1); } #define EXPECT(cond) \ do { \ if (!(cond)) test_fail(__FILE__, __LINE__, S(#cond)); \ } while (0) #define EXPECT_EQ(a, b) \ do { \ uint64_t test_a_ = (uint64_t)(a); \ uint64_t test_b_ = (uint64_t)(b); \ if (test_a_ != test_b_) { \ fprintf(stderr, " %s is %llu, %s is %llu\n", #a, (unsigned long long)test_a_, \ #b, (unsigned long long)test_b_); \ test_fail(__FILE__, __LINE__, S(#a " == " #b)); \ } \ } while (0) // EXPECT_EQ for signed values: both sides as int64_t, printed signed. Under // EXPECT_EQ's uint64_t a failing -1 prints as 18446744073709551615, and -1 // equals SIZE_MAX. #define EXPECT_EQ_I(a, b) \ do { \ int64_t test_a_ = (int64_t)(a); \ int64_t test_b_ = (int64_t)(b); \ if (test_a_ != test_b_) { \ fprintf(stderr, " %s is %lld, %s is %lld\n", #a, (long long)test_a_, \ #b, (long long)test_b_); \ test_fail(__FILE__, __LINE__, S(#a " == " #b)); \ } \ } while (0) #define EXPECT_STR(a, b) \ do { \ Str test_a_ = (a); \ Str test_b_ = (b); \ if (!str_eq(test_a_, test_b_)) { \ fprintf(stderr, " got \"%.*s\"\n want \"%.*s\"\n", (int)test_a_.len, \ test_a_.ptr, (int)test_b_.len, test_b_.ptr); \ test_fail(__FILE__, __LINE__, S(#a " is " #b)); \ } \ } while (0) // `expr` must give OK; when it doesn't, the failure says the stop that the // run `ctx` (a `RunCtx *`) recorded: its place, class, budget if any and // message, or that it recorded none. A host or file system test that fails then // says why, where `EXPECT((expr) == OK)` says only that it stopped. It // reads err.h's RunCtx at its use, so test.h itself still needs only slice. #define EXPECT_OK_IN(ctx, expr) \ do { \ Status test_s_ = (expr); \ if (test_s_ != OK) { \ const RunCtx *test_c_ = (ctx); \ if (test_c_->stopped) { \ const Stop *test_t_ = &test_c_->stop; \ Str test_cls_ = stop_class_name(test_t_->cls); \ Str test_bud_ = budget_name(test_t_->budget); \ fprintf(stderr, " stopped at %u:%u: %.*s%s%.*s: %.*s\n", \ (unsigned)test_t_->line, (unsigned)test_t_->column, \ (int)test_cls_.len, test_cls_.ptr, test_bud_.len > 0 ? " " : "", \ (int)test_bud_.len, test_bud_.ptr, (int)test_t_->message.len, \ test_t_->message.ptr); \ } else { \ fprintf(stderr, " no stop recorded\n"); \ } \ test_fail(__FILE__, __LINE__, S(#expr " is OK")); \ } \ } while (0) // What a bad index calls in an EXPECT_TRAPS child: it exits with // TEST_TRAPPED, so the parent knows the trap and not something else ended it. enum { TEST_TRAPPED = 42 }; static inline void test_trap(const char *file, int line, uint64_t i, size_t len) { // cstr: __FILE__ (void)file; (void)line; (void)i; (void)len; _exit(TEST_TRAPPED); } // Runs `stmt` in a child, its stderr dropped and no core dumped (a core piped // to apport takes a second, and a pipe ignores RLIMIT_CORE, so the child is // made not dumpable), and gives how the child ended. `trap` arms the bounds // trap in the child. A child, not a longjmp: a jump back into the test's frame // would clobber what `stmt` made there (GCC's -Wclobbered). // DRAGON: the process boundary. The child is a fork with no exec, so it must // not outlive the test, and a failed EXPECT inside `stmt` must not jump back // into the child's copy of test_run and run the file's other tests there. // REMEDY: the child takes SIGKILL as its death signal and ends at once if // the parent was gone before it asked (`getppid` no longer the parent); a // failed EXPECT exits it with TEST_CHILD_FAILED; a child that cannot be set // up exits 3. test_test catches a plant of each of the first two. #define TEST_IN_CHILD(stmt, trap, status) \ do { \ fflush(stdout); \ fflush(stderr); \ pid_t test_parent_ = getpid(); \ pid_t test_pid_ = fork(); \ if (test_pid_ == 0) { \ if (prctl(PR_SET_PDEATHSIG, SIGKILL, 0, 0, 0) != 0) _exit(3); \ if (getppid() != test_parent_) _exit(3); \ test_state()->in_child = true; \ if (prctl(PR_SET_DUMPABLE, 0, 0, 0, 0) != 0) _exit(3); \ if (freopen("/dev/null", "w", stderr) == NULL) _exit(3); \ if (trap) *slice_trap_slot() = test_trap; \ stmt; \ _exit(0); \ } \ EXPECT(test_pid_ > 0 && waitpid(test_pid_, &(status), 0) == test_pid_); \ } while (0) // `stmt` must trap on a bad index (slice.h); the test fails if it finishes. #define EXPECT_TRAPS(stmt) \ do { \ int test_status_ = 0; \ TEST_IN_CHILD(stmt, true, test_status_); \ if (!(WIFEXITED(test_status_) && WEXITSTATUS(test_status_) == TEST_TRAPPED)) \ test_fail(__FILE__, __LINE__, S("`" #stmt "` did not trap")); \ } while (0) // `stmt` must end the process with SIGABRT (a bad index with no trap, an // arena misuse). #define EXPECT_DIES(stmt) \ do { \ int test_status_ = 0; \ TEST_IN_CHILD(stmt, false, test_status_); \ if (!(WIFSIGNALED(test_status_) && WTERMSIG(test_status_) == SIGABRT)) \ test_fail(__FILE__, __LINE__, S("`" #stmt "` did not abort")); \ } while (0) // Whether `name` is one of the comma-separated names in `only`. static inline bool test_named(Str only, Str name) { size_t from = 0; for (size_t i = 0; i <= only.len; i++) { if (i < only.len && str_byte(only, i) != ',') continue; if (str_eq(str_sub(only, from, i), name)) return true; from = i + 1; } return false; } // A test file's cases and its name: what a binary runs and counts as one // file. A file of its own is one part (`TEST_MAIN`); a binary of several // files, each a `TEST_PART`, runs each in turn (`TEST_PARTS_MAIN`), so the // interpreter they share is compiled once for all of them. // `cases` is a function, its array static inside it, so a part names no // array of its own beside its `TestPart`. typedef struct { TestCases (*cases)(void); Str file; } TestPart; SLICE_TYPE(TestParts, const TestPart *const); // Whether every comma-separated name in `only` names a case of one of the // parts; the first that doesn't goes in `missing`. static inline bool test_all_named(TestParts parts, Str only, Str *missing) { size_t from = 0; for (size_t i = 0; i <= only.len; i++) { if (i < only.len && str_byte(only, i) != ',') continue; Str name = str_sub(only, from, i); bool found = false; for (size_t p = 0; p < parts.len; p++) { TestCases cases = at(parts, p)->cases(); for (size_t k = 0; k < cases.len; k++) { if (str_eq(at(cases, k).name, name)) found = true; } } if (!found) { *missing = name; return false; } from = i + 1; } return true; } // Runs one case, a failure counted. The setjmp is alone in this function, // so no local of its caller lives across it (GCC's -Wclobbered at -O2). static inline void test_run_case(const TestCase *c) { TestState *t = test_state(); t->current = c->name; if (setjmp(t->back) == 0) { c->fn(); } else { test_state()->failed++; } } // Runs one part's cases, or with `TEST_ONLY` set only those it names, and // says the part's count in a line of its own. A part none of whose cases // `TEST_ONLY` names runs nothing and says nothing. Gives how many ran, and // sets `failed` when one failed. static inline size_t test_run_part(const TestPart *part, const char *only_env, Str only, bool *failed) { // cstr: getenv's TestState *t = test_state(); TestCases cases = part->cases(); Str file = part->file; t->failed = 0; size_t ran = 0; for (size_t k = 0; k < cases.len; k++) { const TestCase *c = &at(cases, k); if (only_env != NULL && !test_named(only, c->name)) continue; test_run_case(c); ran++; } if (ran == 0) return 0; if (t->failed > 0) { fprintf(stderr, "%.*s: %zu of %zu tests failed\n", (int)file.len, file.ptr, t->failed, (size_t)ran); *failed = true; } else { printf("%.*s: %zu tests passed\n", (int)file.len, file.ptr, (size_t)ran); } // The next part's tests fork: a child that exits through stdio would // print this line again. fflush(stdout); return ran; } // Runs every part's cases in order, or with `TEST_ONLY` set, only those it // names (`a,b`), so a planted fault runs only the tests aimed at it. A name // in it that names no case of any part fails the run, so an aim that went // stale can't pass by running nothing. Each part's count printed is of its // cases that ran; `file` is the binary's, for the run's own failures. static inline int test_run(TestParts parts, Str file) { const char *only_env = getenv("TEST_ONLY"); Str only = {"", 0}; if (only_env != NULL) only = (Str){only_env, strlen(only_env)}; Str missing = {"", 0}; if (only_env != NULL && !test_all_named(parts, only, &missing)) { fprintf(stderr, "%.*s: no test named `%.*s`\n", (int)file.len, file.ptr, (int)missing.len, missing.ptr); return 1; } size_t ran = 0; bool failed = false; for (size_t p = 0; p < parts.len; p++) ran += test_run_part(at(parts, p), only_env, only, &failed); if (ran == 0) { fprintf(stderr, "%.*s: no tests\n", (int)file.len, file.ptr); return 1; } return failed ? 1 : 0; } // A test file that is a part of a binary of several: it ends with // `TEST_PART(name, TEST_CASE(a), ...)` where a file of its own ends with // `TEST_MAIN`, and has no `main`. #define TEST_PART(name, ...) \ static TestCases test_part_cases_##name(void) { \ static const TestCase cases[] = {__VA_ARGS__}; \ TestCases all = {cases, sizeof cases / sizeof(TestCase)}; \ return all; \ } \ static const TestPart test_part_##name = {test_part_cases_##name, S_ITEM(__FILE__)} #define TEST_PART_OF(name) &test_part_##name // A file of its own: one part, the file. #define TEST_MAIN(...) \ TEST_PART(main_file, __VA_ARGS__); \ int main(void) { \ static const TestPart *const parts[] = {&test_part_main_file}; \ TestParts all = {parts, 1}; \ return test_run(all, S(__FILE__)); \ } // The binary of several parts: `TEST_PARTS_MAIN(TEST_PART_OF(a), ...)`, after // it includes each part's file. #define TEST_PARTS_MAIN(...) \ int main(void) { \ static const TestPart *const parts[] = {__VA_ARGS__}; \ TestParts all = {parts, sizeof parts / sizeof(const TestPart *)}; \ return test_run(all, S(__FILE__)); \ } #endif

name: repos:shale/c/foundation/slice.h
html: // slice.h: `Str` (a pointer and a length), typed slices, and the one way to // index either. Every index goes through `at(s, i)`, which checks it against // the length in every build: a bad index is a bug in the C, so it ends the // process naming the file and line, never reading past the end. A loop that // has proved its own bounds may opt out with `at_unchecked(s, i, "why")`, // whose reason is a string literal the compiler requires. // // This is the only file allowed a raw `ptr[...]` index; // `c/check_discipline.shale` holds the rest of the C to it. #ifndef SHALE_SLICE_H #define SHALE_SLICE_H #include <stdbool.h> #include <stddef.h> #include <stdint.h> #include <stdio.h> #include <stdlib.h> #include <string.h> // Its bytes need not be UTF-8, and nothing relies on a NUL after them. typedef struct { const char *ptr; size_t len; } Str; // A Str of a string literal; anything else is a compile error. #define S(lit) ((Str){"" lit "", sizeof(lit) - 1}) // `S` as an item of a table sized by its items (`names[]`), a plain brace // initializer: TCC 0.9.27 refuses an unsized array of compound literals, // `S`'s form, with "index too large". #define S_ITEM(lit) {"" lit "", sizeof(lit) - 1} // A typed slice: `SLICE_TYPE(Ints, int64_t);` names a struct of `ptr` and // `len`. #define SLICE_TYPE(Name, T) \ typedef struct { \ T *ptr; \ size_t len; \ } Name SLICE_TYPE(Bytes, char); // A bug in the C, never a script's stop: one line on stderr, `shale: a bug in // the C: <what>`, and the process ends on SIGABRT (a death test's // EXPECT_DIES). A script's mistake or a hostile input is a stop, with its // message, and never comes here. TCC doesn't take `noreturn` as ending the // function, so a caller that gives a value writes a return after the call, // never reached. static inline __attribute__((noreturn)) void c_bug(const char *what) { // cstr: a literal naming the bug fprintf(stderr, "shale: a bug in the C: %s\n", what); fflush(stderr); abort(); } // `n - k`, a count of the C's own taken down: one below zero is a bug in the // C, which Zig's checked arithmetic traps and C's unsigned arithmetic would // wrap to a count near its type's most. static inline uint32_t count_less_u32(uint32_t n, uint32_t k) { if (k > n) c_bug("a count of the C's own taken below zero"); return n - k; } // c_bug, with what the bug was about after its words: `<what>: <detail>`. static inline __attribute__((noreturn)) void c_bug_str(const char *what, Str detail) { // cstr: a literal naming the bug fprintf(stderr, "shale: a bug in the C: %s: %.*s\n", what, (int)detail.len, detail.len == 0 ? "" : detail.ptr); fflush(stderr); abort(); } // What a bad index calls before the process ends. Null ends it at once; a // test's child sets one that exits with a code of its own (`test.h`, // `EXPECT_TRAPS`). // The slot is per translation unit, which is all a test needs. typedef void (*BoundsTrap)(const char *file, int line, uint64_t i, size_t len); // cstr: __FILE__ // DRAGON: bounds. A trap that returns still ends in abort, but one that // longjmps resumes the program after a bad index, as if it had been in // bounds. // REMEDY: only test.h sets a trap, in a death test's child, and its trap // calls `_exit`. static inline BoundsTrap *slice_trap_slot(void) { static BoundsTrap trap; return &trap; } static inline void slice_bounds_failed(const char *file, int line, uint64_t i, size_t len) { // cstr: __FILE__ BoundsTrap trap = *slice_trap_slot(); if (trap != NULL) trap(file, line, i, len); fprintf(stderr, "%s:%d: index %llu is out of bounds for length %zu\n", file, line, (unsigned long long)i, len); abort(); } // `i` is taken as 64 bits and compared with the length in 64 bits, so an // int64_t index is never cut to a 32-bit size_t (the wasm build) before its // check: one past 2^32 traps there as it does on x86-64. static inline size_t slice_check(uint64_t i, size_t len, const char *file, int line) { // cstr: __FILE__ if (i < (uint64_t)len) return (size_t)i; slice_bounds_failed(file, line, i, len); return 0; } // The element at `i`, an lvalue. `s` is evaluated twice, `i` once. // DRAGON: bounds. This is every index's check, and a trap ends the process, // not the run, so a script's bad index must never reach it. // REMEDY: a negative index becomes a huge one and traps, never reading past // the end; a script's index is checked first by its caller, as the `index` // stop, and at() is the backstop. #define at(s, i) ((s).ptr[slice_check((i), (s).len, __FILE__, __LINE__)]) // The element at `i` with no check. `reason` must be a non-empty string // literal saying why the index is in bounds; it costs nothing at run time. // DRAGON: bounds. No check at all. The reason is a comment the compiler // insists on, and nothing holds it true. // REMEDY: a search for `at_unchecked(` lists every use, each with its reason, // and each is read by hand as a raw index. The uses are few: loops bounded // by `len`, and one walk to the MESSAGE_END that ends every list it walks. #define at_unchecked(s, i, reason) \ ((s).ptr[((void)sizeof(char[sizeof("" reason "") > 1 ? 1 : -1]), (i))]) // `from` and `to` checked against `len`, so a part can never reach past it. static inline void slice_range_check(uint64_t from, uint64_t to, size_t len, const char *file, int line) { // cstr: __FILE__ if (from <= to && to <= (uint64_t)len) return; slice_bounds_failed(file, line, from > to ? from : to, len); } // The part `[from, to)` of a typed slice, as the same type. A part from 0 // keeps `ptr` as it is: an empty slice may hold NULL, and `NULL + 0` is // undefined in C11 (neither GCC's UBSan nor clang 22's flags it). // DRAGON: bounds. `from` is evaluated four times and `to` twice, so an // argument with a side effect would be checked as one value and used as // another (`k++` with k = 2 on "abc" makes a part from 3 of length SIZE_MAX, // and GCC says nothing). // REMEDY: check_discipline's `slice args` rule refuses `++`, `--`, `=` and a // call in its arguments; `str_sub`, a function, takes any argument. #define SLICE_SUB(Type, s, from, to) \ (slice_range_check((from), (to), (s).len, __FILE__, __LINE__), \ (Type){(from) == 0 ? (s).ptr : (s).ptr + (from), \ (size_t)(to) - (size_t)(from)}) // The part `[from, to)` of a Str. A function, so each argument is evaluated // once; the macro only hands it the caller's place for a trap. A part from 0 // keeps `ptr`, as SLICE_SUB's does. static inline Str str_sub_at(Str s, uint64_t from, uint64_t to, const char *file, int line) { // cstr: __FILE__ slice_range_check(from, to, s.len, file, line); Str part = {from == 0 ? s.ptr : s.ptr + (size_t)from, (size_t)(to - from)}; return part; } #define str_sub(s, from, to) str_sub_at((s), (from), (to), __FILE__, __LINE__) static inline uint8_t str_byte(Str s, size_t i) { return (uint8_t)at(s, i); } // ── The mem* calls, guarded ─────────────────────────────────────────── // A mem* call on a NULL pointer is undefined in C17 even for 0 bytes, and // glibc marks the arguments nonnull, so GCC may take the pointer as not NULL // and delete a later check of it. An empty Str or slice may hold NULL, so // no code outside c/foundation calls memcpy, memmove, memcmp, memchr or memmem // (c/check_discipline.shale's `raw mem` rule): it calls these, which make no // call for 0 bytes. Inside c/foundation too, these five are the only raw // calls, each under its DRAGON. // Copies `n` bytes from `src` to `dst`, which do not overlap; nothing for 0. static inline void mem_copy(void *dst, const void *src, size_t n) { if (n == 0) return; // DRAGON: NULL pointers. memcpy is undefined on a NULL pointer. // REMEDY: a call for 0 bytes returns above, and a pointer to one byte or // more is never NULL: the arena never hands out NULL for a length past // 0, and a slice or Str of a length past 0 points at its bytes. memcpy(dst, src, n); } // Copies `n` bytes from `src` to `dst`, which may overlap; nothing for 0. static inline void mem_move(void *dst, const void *src, size_t n) { if (n == 0) return; // DRAGON: NULL pointers. memmove is undefined on a NULL pointer. // REMEDY: as mem_copy's, a call for 0 bytes returns above. memmove(dst, src, n); } // memcmp's order of `n` bytes at `a` and `b`; 0 for 0 bytes. static inline int mem_compare(const void *a, const void *b, size_t n) { if (n == 0) return 0; // DRAGON: NULL pointers. memcmp is undefined on a NULL pointer. // REMEDY: as mem_copy's, a call for 0 bytes returns above. return memcmp(a, b, n); } // The first byte `c` in the `n` bytes at `p`, or NULL; NULL for 0 bytes. static inline const char *mem_find_byte(const void *p, int c, size_t n) { if (n == 0) return NULL; // DRAGON: NULL pointers. memchr is undefined on a NULL pointer. // REMEDY: as mem_copy's, a call for 0 bytes returns above. return memchr(p, c, n); } // memmem is a GNU extension, declared only to a unit that defines // _GNU_SOURCE before its first include, as every unit that searches for a // run of bytes does (c/shale.c, c/tests/ran_tests.c, the host's tests). #ifdef _GNU_SOURCE // Where the `needle_len` bytes at `needle` first are in the `hay_len` bytes // at `hay`, as an offset from `hay`, or SIZE_MAX when they are not there. An // empty needle is at 0, in an empty haystack too, as memmem finds one; a // needle longer than the haystack is nowhere. Either may be NULL when its // length is 0. static inline size_t mem_find(const void *hay, size_t hay_len, const void *needle, size_t needle_len) { if (needle_len == 0) return 0; if (needle_len > hay_len) return SIZE_MAX; // DRAGON: NULL pointers. memmem is undefined on a NULL pointer, and glibc // marks its arguments nonnull. // REMEDY: both lengths are past 0 here, as mem_copy's are, so neither // pointer is NULL. const char *hit = memmem(hay, hay_len, needle, needle_len); return hit == NULL ? SIZE_MAX : (size_t)(hit - (const char *)hay); } #endif static inline bool str_eq(Str a, Str b) { return a.len == b.len && mem_compare(a.ptr, b.ptr, a.len) == 0; } static inline bool str_starts_with(Str s, Str prefix) { return s.len >= prefix.len && mem_compare(s.ptr, prefix.ptr, prefix.len) == 0; } // The first `c` in `s`, or NULL when there is none. Every search of a Str's // bytes for one byte comes here. static inline const char *str_find_byte(Str s, char c) { return mem_find_byte(s.ptr, c, s.len); } // ── OS strings, for the kernel ──────────────────────────────────────── // A Str known to hold no NUL: the only string the C hands the kernel (a // path, a program's argument, its folder, an environment entry). Only the // two makers below make one, so a call that takes an OsStr was handed bytes // the kernel will read whole. typedef struct { Str s; } OsStr; // `s` as an OsStr into `*out`, or false when it holds a NUL. The one search // for a NUL in a string bound for the kernel: a script's string comes here // through the host's `os_str` (host.c), which refuses it naming the // argument, and a config file's through its parser (mounts.c's // `mounts_parse`), which names the line. // DRAGON: a NUL inside. A NUL inside `s` would end the kernel's copy early, // so the call would act on a shorter path or word than the one every check // judged (`a\0/../x` checked as one, opened as `a`). // REMEDY: an OsStr is made only here and by os_str_own, which both search // for one, and check_discipline's `nul search` holds every other search to // them; test_file_system holds both sides and catches this one's plant, and // test_run_guards a script's NUL in each of `run`'s and `job_start`'s. static inline bool os_str_of(Str s, OsStr *out) { if (str_find_byte(s, 0) != NULL) return false; // nul: the maker's search out->s = s; return true; } // Shale's own string as an OsStr: one built of others' OsStr parts and // fixed words, or a name the kernel gave (a folder's entry, `realpath`'s // answer), which hold no NUL by how they were made. A NUL in one is a bug // in the C. static inline OsStr os_str_own(Str s) { OsStr o; if (!os_str_of(s, &o)) c_bug("an OS string of Shale's own holds a NUL"); return o; } // `s` with a NUL after it, written at the start of `room`, for a call into // the kernel; false, with nothing written, when it and its NUL don't fit. // The C strings the C makes are made here: arena.h's arena_cstr in an // arena, file_system.c's file_system_cstr on the caller's stack; spawn.c's // PATH candidates alone are joined by hand, of OsStrs' bytes. static inline bool str_cstr_into(Bytes room, OsStr s) { if (s.s.len >= room.len) return false; mem_copy(room.ptr, s.s.ptr, s.s.len); at(room, s.s.len) = 0; return true; } #endif

name: repos:shale/c/foundation/status.h
html: // status.h: what every function that can stop returns. `STOP` means the run // stopped and its context (`RunCtx`, err.h) says where and why; a container // that returns `STOP` was refused by its arena, which the caller reads as the // arena budget (`run_oom`). err.h is the convention's home; this is its one // enum, apart so that the containers below err.h can return it. #ifndef SHALE_STATUS_H #define SHALE_STATUS_H typedef enum { OK = 0, STOP = 1 } Status; // On every function that returns a Status. A STOP dropped on the floor lets // the run go on past an arena refusal, where it must stop, so GCC refuses an // answer left unused, even one cast to void. TCC lacks the check, so the GCC // builds hold the C to it, and check_discipline's `must use` rule holds every // such function to carry it. #if defined(__GNUC__) && !defined(__TINYC__) #define STATUS_MUST_USE __attribute__((warn_unused_result)) #else #define STATUS_MUST_USE #endif // Returns STOP from the enclosing function when `expr` does. #define TRY(expr) \ do { \ if ((expr) != OK) return STOP; \ } while (0) #endif

name: repos:shale/c/script/run.h
html: // run.h: a run's state and the semantics every op and builtin shares: the steps // and the budgets, the output, the stack of frames' slots, indexing, // arithmetic, comparison, `..` chains and `attempt`'s answers. Its messages // are held by the goldens (tests/golden/), and a script sees its step // charges through the budgets, so neither changes freely. #ifndef SHALE_RUN_H #define SHALE_RUN_H #include "../foundation/err.h" #include "cli.h" #include "regex.h" #include "compile.h" #include "value.h" // The most arguments any builtin but `print` takes. enum { BUILTINS_ARGS_MAX = 4 }; SLICE_TYPE(ConstValues, const Value); // RUN_COLD keeps a function out of the code that calls it, and a call of it // off the hot path's line: a stop's path, an op's rare work, whose locals // and saved registers would otherwise weigh on every op. RUN_HOT makes GCC // inline a small one that `at`'s trap, inlined into it, makes look too big // to. TCC takes neither, and needs neither. #if defined(__GNUC__) && !defined(__TINYC__) #define RUN_COLD __attribute__((cold)) #define RUN_HOT __attribute__((always_inline)) #else #define RUN_COLD #define RUN_HOT #endif typedef struct Run Run; // What one spender of a run's steps spent, for the report's `── steps:` line: // its steps, and the calls of it from script code. typedef struct { uint64_t steps; uint64_t calls; } StepsSpent; SLICE_TYPE(StepsSpents, StepsSpent); // The file system a run's paths reach, its hook and its effects log, as // builtins_files.c defines it; NULL for a run with no file system. typedef struct RunFiles RunFiles; // The core's one way out to its host: `host(name, ...)` calls `call` with the // name and the rest of its arguments. NULL `call` is no host. typedef struct { void *ctx; Status (*call)(void *ctx, Run *r, Pos pos, Str name, ConstValues args, Value *out); } RunHost; // The text of a 64-bit integer in decimal. typedef struct { char bytes[24]; } IntText; enum { // The numbers' texts a run holds at once for its messages (run_num). RUN_NUMS = 16, }; typedef struct Run { // The stop's place and the calls in progress; `ctx.values` is the values' // arena, `ctx.function` the function the run is in. RunCtx ctx; // The frames' slots, the operands and the frames, under the machine budget. Arena *machine; const Program *program; uint64_t steps; // Calls of script functions in progress. uint32_t depth; int64_t now; // What `print` wrote, at most `out_cap` bytes, in an arena of its own. Buf out; size_t out_cap; const Arg *args; size_t args_len; uint64_t reads; uint64_t read_bytes; uint64_t changes; uint64_t change_bytes; uint32_t host_runs; bool tried_change; uint64_t collections; // Every frame's slots, one stack, each call's frame on top; `base` is the // current frame's first. ValueVec stack; size_t base; // The top-level `const`s, each unset until its line has run. Value *consts; size_t consts_len; // The last string a `..` chain built: its buffer, how much of it the // string fills, and the buffer's size, so `s = s .. x` is linear. char *tail_ptr; // cstr: its size is `tail_cap` size_t tail_used; size_t tail_cap; // The patterns `re_find` and its kin compiled. RegexCache patterns; RunFiles *files; RunHost host; // The host call running (`host("real", ...)`'s `real`), "" outside one: // a stop the host's code meets in a builtin's checks names it. Str host_call; // Where the steps went: slot 0 is the script's own code (what the others // leave, vm_steps_top), then one slot a builtin, in ast.h's order, then // one a function of the code, which only a function of Shale's own // preludes spends in. Empty until vm_main makes it, and then nothing is // counted. TRY(run_map_put_int(r, pos, site, S("line"), c.line)); TRY(run_map_put_int(r, pos, site, S("column"), c.column)); Value sv; value_table(&sv, site); TRY(run_list_push(r, pos, trail, &sv)); } if (s->trail.len > 0) trail->kind = TABLE_LIST; Value tv; value_table(&tv, trail); TRY(run_map_put(r, pos, out, S("trail"), &tv)); value_table(v, out); return OK; } // `{ok = true, value = got}`, no `value` for nil. static inline STATUS_MUST_USE Status run_attempt_returned(Run *r, Pos pos, Table *out, const Value *got, Value *v) { TRY(run_map_put_bool(r, pos, out, S("ok"), true)); if (got->tag != VALUE_NIL) TRY(run_map_put(r, pos, out, S("value"), got)); value_table(v, out); return OK; } #endif

html: // regex.h: the linear-time regular expressions behind `re_find`, `re_match`, // `re_replace`, `re_find_all` and the host's `re_lines`. // // A pattern compiles to a Pike VM program. A search advances every thread a // byte at a time in order of preference and follows each state at most once a // position, so it finds the match a backtracker would find first, in at most // (bytes + 1) times the program's states, whatever the pattern. The counts a // search gives (`positions`, `skipped`, `work`) are what the builtins charge // steps by, so a change to them changes every regex builtin's cost. Shale has // its own engine so that every search is linear in its input: PCRE backtracks, // and RE2 is C++. // // The functions are in regex.c, which a program includes after this header: // the C is one translation unit, every function `static`. #ifndef SHALE_REGEX_H #define SHALE_REGEX_H #include "arena.h" #include "status.h" enum { // The longest pattern; a longer one is refused before it is read. REGEX_PATTERN_MAX = 256, // The most capture groups: `\1` to `\9` in a replacement. REGEX_GROUPS_MAX = 9, // The largest count a `{n,m}` may give. REGEX_COUNT_MAX = 100, // The most instructions a program may have, its counts written out, so a // place fits a uint16_t. REGEX_INSTS_MAX = 8192, // Loops whose turn can take nothing: at most 16 a pattern, nested at most // 4 deep, so a position holds at most 16 states an instruction. REGEX_EMPTY_LOOPS_MAX = 16, REGEX_NEST_MAX = 4, // A thread's captures: the match's start, then each group's start and end. REGEX_CAPS = 1 + 2 * REGEX_GROUPS_MAX, // The compiled patterns a run keeps, the least recently used evicted. REGEX_CACHE_MAX = 8, }; typedef enum { // The byte `c`. REGEX_OP_BYTE, // Any byte but a newline. REGEX_OP_ANY, // A byte in set `x`. REGEX_OP_SET, // Continue at `x`, and, less preferred, at `y`. REGEX_OP_SPLIT, REGEX_OP_JMP, // Record the position in capture slot `x`. REGEX_OP_SAVE, REGEX_OP_START, REGEX_OP_END, // A word edge (`c` 0) or not one (`c` 1). REGEX_OP_BOUNDARY, // A turn of loop `x` begins: its "took something" bit is cleared. REGEX_OP_TURN, // A turn of loop `x` ends: one that took nothing ends the loop here. REGEX_OP_AGAIN, // A `+`'s first turn ends: one that took nothing goes on at `y`. REGEX_OP_FIRST, REGEX_OP_MATCH, } RegexOp; // Six bytes: `op` is a RegexOp held in a uint8_t. With a 4-byte enum `op` it // would be 12, a size TCC 0.9.27 miscompiles when a function returns it // straight into a call (style.md, "Declarations"). `regex_emit` takes the // fields. typedef struct { uint8_t op; uint8_t c; uint16_t x; uint16_t y; } RegexInst; _Static_assert(sizeof(RegexInst) == 6, "an instruction is six bytes"); // 256 bits, one a byte. typedef struct { uint64_t words[4]; } RegexSet; // The loops whose turn can take nothing around one instruction, by number. typedef struct { uint8_t n; uint8_t ids[REGEX_NEST_MAX]; } RegexEncl; SLICE_TYPE(RegexInsts, RegexInst); SLICE_TYPE(RegexSets, RegexSet); SLICE_TYPE(RegexEncls, RegexEncl); SLICE_TYPE(RegexBases, uint32_t); typedef struct { RegexInsts insts; RegexSets sets; uint8_t groups; // Whether every alternative begins with `^`. bool anchored; RegexEncls encl; // Where each instruction's states start, one for each setting of its // `encl` bits. RegexBases base; // The states a position can hold: what a search is charged per position. uint32_t states; // The bytes a match can begin with, when every match takes one and some // byte cannot begin one. While no thread is alive, a search skips the rest. bool has_first; RegexSet first; // The one byte in `first` when it holds just one, which a search skips to // by `memchr`, else -1; found when the pattern compiles, not per search. int first_only; } RegexProgram; typedef struct { // ASCII letters match either case, folded at compile time; a class is // folded before its `^` is applied, as in Python. bool nocase; } RegexOptions; // Why a pattern was refused: `refused` set, the byte offset, and the text. typedef struct { bool refused; size_t at; Str message; } RegexRefusal; typedef struct { uint16_t pc; size_t caps[REGEX_CAPS]; // Bit k set when loop k's turn has taken a byte. uint16_t flags; } RegexThread; SLICE_TYPE(RegexThreads, RegexThread); SLICE_TYPE(RegexStamps, uint64_t); // The threads at one position, in order of preference. `stamp[st] == now` // marks a state already followed here; a reset advances `now`. typedef struct { RegexThreads threads; RegexStamps stamp; uint64_t now; size_t len; } RegexList; // A program's working memory, made once and reused by every search. typedef struct { RegexList a; RegexList b; // A split's second way, waiting while its first is followed. RegexThreads stack; } RegexScratch; // A group the match passed through, `[start, end)` of the string. typedef struct { bool matched; size_t start; size_t end; } RegexGroup; typedef struct { size_t start; size_t end; // Group 1 first; those past the program's `groups` are unmatched. RegexGroup groups[REGEX_GROUPS_MAX]; } RegexFound; typedef struct { bool found; // Written only when `found`: a miss leaves it unset, so a search per line // zeroes nothing it will not read. RegexFound match; // Positions examined; a search costs this times the program's states. uint64_t positions; // Bytes passed over while no thread was alive, each looked at once. uint64_t skipped; // Instructions followed (the run's `work` tally). uint64_t work; // False when a count in RegexMost stopped the search early. bool finished; } RegexSearched; // How far a search may go before it stops unfinished. typedef struct { uint64_t positions; uint64_t skipped; } RegexMost; typedef struct { bool present; // The entry's own arena: its program, its scratch and its text, all given // back at once when it is evicted. Arena arena; Str text; bool nocase; RegexProgram program; RegexScratch scratch; uint64_t used; } RegexCached; SLICE_TYPE(RegexEntries, RegexCached); typedef struct { RegexCached entries[REGEX_CACHE_MAX]; uint64_t clock; // The run's refusal, which each entry's arena sets when it refuses. bool *refused; } RegexCache; #endif

html: // shale.c: the C `shale` command: it reads the command line, the mounts, // the script and the preludes, parses and compiles the script with them, // and either stops there (`--check`) or runs it on the VM (script/vm.c), // printing what it printed on stdout and its report on stderr, with its exit // code. A host call the C does not run yet is refused as not ported. // `--help` and `--version` print the usage and the build's mode, `--secrets` // is a person's commands for the secrets mounts (host/secrets_mode.c), and // `--reap` is a job's reaper (host/jobs.c). This file holds the system // calls; what it decides is in script/. // `realpath`, `openat` and `memmem` are GNU's. #define _GNU_SOURCE #include <errno.h> #include <fcntl.h> #include <limits.h> #include <stdlib.h> #include <sys/stat.h> #include <time.h> #include <unistd.h> #include "script/run.h" #include "host/file_system.c" #include "host/path_run.c" #include "script/regex.c" #include "script/builtins.c" #include "script/builtins_text.c" #include "script/builtins_files.c" #include "script/builtins_walk.c" #include "script/builtins_change.c" #include "script/vm.c" #include "host/mounts.c" #include "host/paths.c" #include "host/undo.c" #include "host/spawn_argv.c" #include "host/pgroup.c" #include "host/spawn_child.c" #include "host/spawn.c" #include "host/keep.c" #include "host/swap_file.c" #include "host/job_record.c" #include "host/jobs.c" #include "host/host.c" #include "host/host_refusals.c" #include "host/host_write_gate.c" #include "host/host_run_secrets.c" #include "host/host_run.c" #include "host/host_jobs.c" #include "host/host_procs.c" #include "host/host_json.c" #include "host/host_text.c" #include "host/host_grep_tree.c" #include "host/flat_tree.c" #include "host/zig_wire.c" #include "host/zig_ast.c" #include "host/host_zig.c" #include "host/host_call.c" #include "host/settings_json.c" #include "host/secrets_mode.c" #include "preludes.h" enum { // Exit codes: finished, stopped, could not begin. EXIT_FINISHED = 0, EXIT_STOPPED = 1, EXIT_REFUSED = 2, // Room for the parse beyond the machine budget: the C's tree is laid out // for itself, and its working lists stay in the arena, so the budget's own // bytes are no measure of it. // DRAGON: the machine budget. The parse's arena is bounded, but not at // Zig's `budget machine` stop: a source that stops there in Zig parses // here. // REMEDY: the source budget (64 KiB) bounds the tree, so the arena can't // grow without end. PARSE_ROOM = 256 * 1024 * 1024, }; // The CLI's own arena, what it says on stderr, and the refusal its arena and // the parse's set: the CLI's setup is outside any run, and a run's arenas set // the run's own (`RunCtx.refused`). typedef struct { Arena *arena; Buf err; bool *refused; } Out; // The name of a failed open or read, as the messages print it. static Str error_name(int e) { switch (e) { case ENOENT: return S("FileNotFound"); case EISDIR: return S("IsDir"); case ENOTDIR: return S("NotDir"); case EACCES: return S("AccessDenied"); case EPERM: return S("PermissionDenied"); case ELOOP: return S("SymLinkLoop"); case ENAMETOOLONG: return S("NameTooLong"); default: return S("Unexpected"); } } static Str from_c(const char *s) { // cstr: the system's own Str r = {s, strlen(s)}; return r; } // Reads all of `fd` into the arena, at most `limit` bytes; more is refused // as StreamTooLong. static STATUS_MUST_USE Status read_all(Arena *a, int fd, size_t limit, Str *out, Str *err) { Buf b = buf_make(a); char chunk[16384]; for (;;) { ssize_t n = read(fd, chunk, sizeof chunk); if (n < 0) { if (errno == EINTR) continue; *err = error_name(errno); return STOP; } if (n == 0) break; if (b.len + (size_t)n > limit) { *err = S("StreamTooLong"); return STOP; } Str got = {chunk, (size_t)n}; if (buf_str(&b, got) != OK) { *err = S("OutOfMemory"); return STOP; } } *out = buf_view(&b); return OK; } // The file at `path`, at most `limit` bytes, into `*out`; STOP with the // error's name in `*err`. `path` is the CLI's own: an argument or the // environment's, which the kernel handed over NUL-ended, or one made of // them and strict names. static STATUS_MUST_USE Status read_path(Arena *a, Str path, size_t limit, Str *out, Str *err) { const char *p = arena_cstr(a, os_str_own(path)); if (p == NULL) { *err = S("OutOfMemory"); return STOP; } int fd = open(p, O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC); if (fd < 0) { *err = error_name(errno); return STOP; } Status s = read_all(a, fd, limit, out, err); close(fd); return s; } // The real path of `p` into `*out`, or `p` itself when it has none (it is // missing); STOP when the arena refuses. `p` is the CLI's own, as // read_path's is. static STATUS_MUST_USE Status real_or_same(Arena *a, Str p, Str *out) { *out = p; const char *c = arena_cstr(a, os_str_own(p)); if (c == NULL) return STOP; char buf[PATH_MAX]; if (realpath(c, buf) == NULL) return OK; // skip: no real path is `p` as given if (!arena_dup(a, from_c(buf), out)) return STOP; return OK; } static STATUS_MUST_USE Status join(Arena *a, Str x, Str y, Str *out) { Buf b = buf_make(a); TRY(buf_str(&b, x)); if (!(x.len > 0 && str_byte(x, x.len - 1) == '/')) TRY(buf_byte(&b, '/')); TRY(buf_str(&b, y)); *out = buf_view(&b); return OK; } static void say(Out *o, Str s) { if (buf_str(&o->err, s) != OK) o->err.len = 0; } // Writes what is said so far to stderr, and empties it. static void flush_err(Out *o) { if (o->err.len > 0) { size_t n = fwrite(o->err.ptr, 1, o->err.len, stderr); (void)n; } fflush(stderr); buf_clear(&o->err); } static int flush_and_exit(Out *o, int code) { flush_err(o); return code; } // A command line refused: `shale: <why>`, then the usage. An empty `why` // is the arena's refusal (cli_refuse_parts leaves it empty): out of memory. static int refuse_command(Out *o, Str why, bool usage) { say(o, S("shale: ")); say(o, why.len > 0 ? why : S("out of memory")); say(o, S("\n")); if (usage) say(o, cli_usage()); return flush_and_exit(o, EXIT_REFUSED); } // The arena refused what the CLI makes for itself (`what`): `shale: out of // memory: <what>`, the refusal's exit. static int out_of_memory(Out *o, Str what) { say(o, S("shale: out of memory: ")); say(o, what); say(o, S("\n")); return flush_and_exit(o, EXIT_REFUSED); } // The working folder could not be read (`getcwd` failed with `e`), the // refusal's exit: `shale: the working folder is gone (FileNotFound)` for a // folder removed under the process, else `... cannot be read (<errno's // name>)`. static int no_working_folder(Out *o, int e) { say(o, e == ENOENT ? S("shale: the working folder is gone (") : S("shale: the working folder cannot be read (")); say(o, error_name(e)); say(o, S(")\n")); return flush_and_exit(o, EXIT_REFUSED); } // ── `use`'s reader ── // Where a `use("./x.shale")` looks: beside the script's file, in a mount or // under the root, or nowhere, for a script with no file or one in a folder // the run may not read. typedef enum { BESIDE_STDIN, BESIDE_SOURCE, BESIDE_MOUNT, BESIDE_ROOT, BESIDE_OUTSIDE, } BesideKind; typedef struct { BesideKind kind; // The script's folder as a path a `./` path's rest is appended to: // `name:sub/dir/` in a mount, `sub/dir/` under the root ("" at its top), // or the OS folder, for BESIDE_OUTSIDE's message. Str dir; } Beside; typedef struct { Arena *arena; MountsItems mounts; Str mounts_from; Budgets budgets; Used used; Beside beside; // The root's real path, which a `./` path under the root is read below. Str root_abs; } LibraryReader; // The stop a reader's failure becomes: `why`, the message the run stops // with, which its loader takes and clears. static STATUS_MUST_USE Status reader_why_parts(Str *why, bool *got, Arena *a, StrPieces parts, size_t n) { StrParts all = {parts.piece, n}; *got = false; Buf b = buf_make(a); for (size_t k = 0; k < all.len; k++) TRY(buf_str(&b, at(all, k))); *why = buf_view(&b); return OK; } #define reader_why(why, got, n, a, ...) reader_why_parts((why), (got), (a), (StrPieces){{__VA_ARGS__}}, (n)) // A charge past the step budget: the count is left one past it, and the // budget's stop says how many steps it had. static STATUS_MUST_USE Status steps_ran_out(LibraryReader *r, Str *why) { r->used.steps = r->budgets.steps + 1; Buf b = buf_make(r->arena); TRY(buf_lit(&b, "the step budget (")); TRY(buf_u64(&b, r->budgets.steps)); TRY(buf_lit(&b, " steps) ran out")); *why = buf_view(&b); return OK; } // Whether any part of `rest` below the mount's folder `dir` is a symbolic // link, each part checked with `lstat` and charged a step, a missing part // ending the walk. On a link, `*why` names it. // DRAGON: the file system's boundary. The file system follows no link below a // mount's folder, so a link there could lead a library's read out of it. // REMEDY: this walk refuses one before the read; a link made between the // walk and the open is a race left open. static STATUS_MUST_USE Status refuse_links(LibraryReader *r, Str dir, Str rest, Str prefix, Str *why, bool *refused) { *refused = false; if (rest.len == 0) return OK; Arena *a = r->arena; Str sofar = dir; Str left = rest; bool done = false; Str part; size_t shown_end = 0; while (cli_split(&left, &done, '/', &part)) { if (r->used.steps >= r->budgets.steps) { TRY(steps_ran_out(r, why)); *refused = true; return OK; } r->used.steps++; TRY(join(a, sofar, part, &sofar)); shown_end += part.len + (shown_end > 0 ? 1 : 0); // A mount's folder, then strict names. const char *c = arena_cstr(a, os_str_own(sofar)); if (c == NULL) return STOP; struct stat st; if (lstat(c, &st) != 0) return OK; // skip: a missing part is the read's own stop if (S_ISLNK(st.st_mode)) { bool got; TRY(reader_why(why, &got, 3, a, prefix, str_sub(rest, 0, shown_end), S(" is a symbolic link: the file system follows none"))); *refused = true; return OK; } } return OK; } // What is left of a budget, never wrapping below zero once a // charge has stopped one past it. static uint64_t sat_sub(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) { return a > b ? a - b : 0; } // A library loaded over the Linux host's mounts: the path resolved as a // script's path to a mount is, the file read and charged as a `read` of it // is. static STATUS_MUST_USE Status load_library(void *ctx, Arena *into, Str path, Str *why, Str *out, Str *name_out, bool *got) { LibraryReader *r = ctx; Arena *a = r->arena; *got = false; *name_out = S(""); // `pathArg` charges a step a byte of the path. if (path.len > sat_sub(r->budgets.steps, r->used.steps)) { TRY(steps_ran_out(r, why)); return OK; } r->used.steps += path.len; // A `./` path is the script folder's: in a mount it is read as that // mount's path, under the root as the root's. bool under_root = false; if (str_starts_with(path, S("./"))) { Str below = str_sub(path, 2, path.len); switch (r->beside.kind) { case BESIDE_STDIN: return reader_why(why, got, 1, a, S("a `./` path is beside the script's own file, and a script on stdin has none: name the library through a mount (`cookbook:c/items.shale`)")); case BESIDE_SOURCE: return reader_why(why, got, 1, a, S("a `./` path is beside the script's own file, and a script given by `-e` has none: name the library through a mount (`cookbook:c/items.shale`)")); case BESIDE_OUTSIDE: return reader_why(why, got, 3, a, S("a `./` path is beside the script's own file, and its folder, "), r->beside.dir, S(", is under neither the root nor a mount: name the library through a mount (`cookbook:c/items.shale`)")); case BESIDE_MOUNT: break; case BESIDE_ROOT: under_root = true; break; } Buf full = buf_make(a); TRY(buf_str(&full, r->beside.dir)); TRY(buf_str(&full, below)); path = buf_view(&full); *name_out = path; } size_t colon = under_root ? 0 : cli_index_of(path, ':'); Str name = str_sub(path, 0, colon); Mount root_folder = {0}; memset(&root_folder, 0, sizeof root_folder); root_folder.name = S(""); root_folder.dir = r->root_abs; Mount *m = under_root ? &root_folder : NULL; for (size_t k = 0; !under_root && k < r->mounts.len; k++) { if (str_eq(at(r->mounts, k).name, name)) m = &at(r->mounts, k); } if (m == NULL) { Buf names = buf_make(a); for (size_t k = 0; k < r->mounts.len; k++) { if (k > 0 && buf_lit(&names, ", ") != OK) return STOP; if (buf_byte(&names, '`') != OK || buf_str(&names, at(r->mounts, k).name) != OK || buf_byte(&names, '`') != OK) return STOP; } if (r->mounts.len == 0) return reader_why(why, got, 7, a, S("\""), path, S("\": `"), name, S(":` is not a mount: there are none ("), r->mounts_from, S(")")); return reader_why(why, got, 9, a, S("\""), path, S("\": `"), name, S(":` is not a mount: the mounts are "), buf_view(&names), S(" ("), r->mounts_from, S(")")); } if (m->secrets) return reader_why(why, got, 5, a, S("\""), path, S("\": the mount `"), m->name, S("` holds secrets: only `run`'s `secrets` (or `http_get`'s `bearer`) may name its files")); Str rest = under_root ? path : str_sub(path, colon + 1, path.len); Str prefix = under_root ? S("") : str_sub(path, 0, colon + 1); if (str_eq(rest, S("."))) rest = S(""); if (rest.len > 0 && str_byte(rest, 0) == '/') return reader_why(why, got, 3, a, S("\""), path, S("\" is absolute inside its mount: a mount's paths are relative to it")); Str left = rest; bool done = rest.len == 0; Str part = {0}; while (cli_split(&left, &done, '/', &part)) { if (str_eq(part, S(".."))) return reader_why(why, got, 3, a, S("\""), path, S("\" climbs out of its mount with `..`: a folder beside it is reached through a mount of its own (`shale --help` lists this box's mounts)")); if (!path_strict_name(part)) return reader_why(why, got, 5, a, S("\""), path, S("\" has a part (\""), part, S("\") that is not a name: no `.`, `..`, empty parts or characters a strict name refuses")); } // A mount's folder holds no NUL (mounts_parse), nor does the root's. const char *dir_c = arena_cstr(a, os_str_own(m->dir)); struct stat dst; if (dir_c == NULL) return STOP; int dir_err = stat(dir_c, &dst) != 0 ? errno : S_ISDIR(dst.st_mode) ? 0 : ENOTDIR; if (dir_err != 0) { Str said = S(""); if (!mounts_folder_failed(a, r->mounts, m, file_system_err_of(dir_err), &said)) return STOP; return reader_why(why, got, 1, a, said); } bool linked = false; TRY(refuse_links(r, m->dir, rest, prefix, why, &linked)); if (linked) return OK; Str full = m->dir; if (rest.len > 0) TRY(join(a, m->dir, rest, &full)); // DRAGON: the secrets rule. A secrets mount's folder may sit inside another // mount's, and a library read through the outer one would put a token's // bytes in a parse's messages (a name, a number). // REMEDY: every path in such a folder is refused here, as paths.c refuses // a script's. for (size_t k = 0; k < r->mounts.len; k++) { const Mount *sm = &at(r->mounts, k); if (sm->secrets && mounts_in_folder(full, sm->dir)) return reader_why(why, got, 5, a, S("\""), path, S("\" is in the mount `"), sm->name, S("`, which holds secrets")); } // `countRead`: the read's count first, then the file's size. if (r->used.reads >= r->budgets.reads) { *why = S("the file-system read budget (count) ran out"); return OK; } r->used.reads++; const char *full_c = arena_cstr(a, os_str_own(full)); struct stat st; if (full_c == NULL) return STOP; if (stat(full_c, &st) != 0) { if (errno == ENOENT) return reader_why(why, got, 3, a, S("`read(\""), path, S("\")`: not found (FileNotFound): `exists(p)` asks first")); return reader_why(why, got, 5, a, S("`read(\""), path, S("\")`: the file system failed ("), error_name(errno), S(")")); } if (!S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) return reader_why(why, got, 3, a, S("`read(\""), path, S("\")`: a folder, not a file (IsDir): `is_dir(p)` asks first")); uint64_t size = (uint64_t)st.st_size; if (size > r->budgets.source_bytes) { *why = S("the library is larger than the source budget"); return OK; } if (size > sat_sub(r->budgets.read_bytes, r->used.read_bytes)) { *why = S("the file-system read budget (bytes) ran out"); return OK; } Str text = {0}; Str err = {0}; if (read_path(into, full, (size_t)size, &text, &err) != OK) { if (str_eq(err, S("OutOfMemory"))) return STOP; return reader_why(why, got, 5, a, S("`read(\""), path, S("\")`: the file system failed ("), err, S(")")); Arena a; arena_init(&a, 1 << 20, &refused); IntMap m = IntMap_make(&a); int64_t v = 0; EXPECT(!IntMap_get(&m, S("x"), &v)); EXPECT(IntMap_ptr(&m, S("x")) == NULL); EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, S("x"), 1) == OK); EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, S("y"), 2) == OK); EXPECT(IntMap_get(&m, S("x"), &v)); EXPECT_EQ_I(v, 1); EXPECT(IntMap_get(&m, S("y"), &v)); EXPECT_EQ_I(v, 2); EXPECT(!IntMap_get(&m, S("z"), &v)); EXPECT_EQ(IntMap_len(&m), 2); *IntMap_ptr(&m, S("y")) = 20; EXPECT(IntMap_get(&m, S("y"), &v)); EXPECT_EQ_I(v, 20); arena_deinit(&a); } TEST(keys_are_bytes_and_their_length) { bool refused = false; Arena a; arena_init(&a, 1 << 20, &refused); IntMap m = IntMap_make(&a); EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, S(""), 1) == OK); EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, S("a"), 2) == OK); EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, S("a\0"), 3) == OK); EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, S("A"), 4) == OK); EXPECT_EQ(IntMap_len(&m), 4); int64_t v = 0; EXPECT(IntMap_get(&m, S(""), &v) && v == 1); EXPECT(IntMap_get(&m, S("a"), &v) && v == 2); EXPECT(IntMap_get(&m, S("a\0"), &v) && v == 3); EXPECT(IntMap_get(&m, S("A"), &v) && v == 4); arena_deinit(&a); } TEST(setting_a_key_again_keeps_its_place) { bool refused = false; Arena a; arena_init(&a, 1 << 20, &refused); IntMap m = IntMap_make(&a); EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, S("b"), 1) == OK); EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, S("a"), 2) == OK); EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, S("b"), 3) == OK); EXPECT_EQ(IntMap_len(&m), 2); EXPECT_STR(IntMap_key_at(&m, 0), S("b")); EXPECT_EQ_I(IntMap_value_at(&m, 0), 3); EXPECT_STR(IntMap_key_at(&m, 1), S("a")); EXPECT_EQ_I(IntMap_value_at(&m, 1), 2); EXPECT_TRAPS((void)IntMap_key_at(&m, 2)); EXPECT_TRAPS((void)IntMap_value_at(&m, 2)); arena_deinit(&a); } // "k<i>" in the arena, so the key outlives the loop that made it. static Str key_of(Arena *a, int64_t i) { Buf b = buf_make(a); if (buf_byte(&b, 'k') != OK || buf_i64(&b, i) != OK) abort(); return buf_view(&b); } TEST(a_thousand_keys_keep_their_order_through_every_growth) { bool refused = false; Arena a; arena_init(&a, 16 * 1024 * 1024, &refused); IntMap m = IntMap_make(&a); for (int64_t i = 0; i < 1000; i++) { // Every other one backwards, so the order is not the keys' sorted // order. int64_t k = i % 2 == 0 ? i : 1000 - i; EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, key_of(&a, k), k * 10) == OK); } EXPECT_EQ(IntMap_len(&m), 1000); EXPECT(m.core.index_cap * 3 >= m.core.len * 4); for (int64_t i = 0; i < 1000; i++) { int64_t k = i % 2 == 0 ? i : 1000 - i; EXPECT_STR(IntMap_key_at(&m, (size_t)i), key_of(&a, k)); int64_t v = -1; EXPECT(IntMap_get(&m, key_of(&a, k), &v)); EXPECT_EQ_I(v, k * 10); } EXPECT(!IntMap_get(&m, S("k1000x"), &(int64_t){0})); arena_deinit(&a); } TEST(a_removal_keeps_the_others_order_and_finds_them_after) { bool refused = false; Arena a; arena_init(&a, 1 << 20, &refused); IntMap m = IntMap_make(&a); Str names[] = {S_ITEM("e"), S_ITEM("d"), S_ITEM("c"), S_ITEM("b"), S_ITEM("a")}; MapKeys all = {names, sizeof names / sizeof *names}; for (size_t i = 0; i < all.len; i++) EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, at(all, i), (int64_t)i) == OK); EXPECT(IntMap_remove(&m, S("c"))); EXPECT(!IntMap_remove(&m, S("c"))); EXPECT(!IntMap_remove(&m, S("zz"))); EXPECT_EQ(IntMap_len(&m), 4); EXPECT_STR(IntMap_key_at(&m, 0), S("e")); EXPECT_STR(IntMap_key_at(&m, 1), S("d")); EXPECT_STR(IntMap_key_at(&m, 2), S("b")); EXPECT_STR(IntMap_key_at(&m, 3), S("a")); EXPECT_EQ_I(IntMap_value_at(&m, 2), 3); EXPECT_EQ_I(IntMap_value_at(&m, 3), 4); int64_t v = -1; EXPECT(IntMap_get(&m, S("a"), &v) && v == 4); EXPECT(IntMap_get(&m, S("e"), &v) && v == 0); EXPECT(!IntMap_get(&m, S("c"), &v)); // Set again, a removed key goes last. EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, S("c"), 9) == OK); EXPECT_STR(IntMap_key_at(&m, 4), S("c")); EXPECT(IntMap_remove(&m, S("a"))); EXPECT(IntMap_remove(&m, S("e"))); EXPECT_STR(IntMap_key_at(&m, 0), S("d")); EXPECT_STR(IntMap_key_at(&m, 2), S("c")); EXPECT(IntMap_get(&m, S("c"), &v) && v == 9); arena_deinit(&a); } TEST(removing_every_key_leaves_an_empty_map_that_takes_keys_again) { bool refused = false; Arena a; arena_init(&a, 1 << 20, &refused); IntMap m = IntMap_make(&a); for (int64_t i = 0; i < 50; i++) EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, key_of(&a, i), i) == OK); for (int64_t i = 0; i < 50; i++) EXPECT(IntMap_remove(&m, key_of(&a, i))); EXPECT_EQ(IntMap_len(&m), 0); int64_t v = 0; EXPECT(!IntMap_get(&m, key_of(&a, 7), &v)); EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, S("again"), 1) == OK); EXPECT_STR(IntMap_key_at(&m, 0), S("again")); arena_deinit(&a); } TEST(a_refused_put_leaves_the_map_as_it_was) { bool refused = false; Arena a; arena_init(&a, 16384, &refused); Arena names; arena_init(&names, 1 << 20, &refused); IntMap m = IntMap_make(&a); size_t n = 0; while (IntMap_put(&m, key_of(&names, (int64_t)n), (int64_t)n) == OK) n++; EXPECT(a.hit); EXPECT(n > 10); EXPECT_EQ(IntMap_len(&m), n); int64_t v = -1; EXPECT(!IntMap_get(&m, key_of(&names, (int64_t)n), &v)); for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { v = -1; EXPECT(IntMap_get(&m, key_of(&names, (int64_t)i), &v)); EXPECT_EQ_I(v, (int64_t)i); EXPECT_STR(IntMap_key_at(&m, i), key_of(&names, (int64_t)i)); } // With room again, the put that was refused goes through, and goes last. a.limit = 1 << 20; EXPECT(IntMap_put(&m, key_of(&names, (int64_t)n), (int64_t)n) == OK); EXPECT_STR(IntMap_key_at(&m, n), key_of(&names, (int64_t)n)); arena_deinit(&a); arena_deinit(&names); } TEST_MAIN( TEST_CASE(put_then_get_and_a_missing_key_is_missing), TEST_CASE(keys_are_bytes_and_their_length), TEST_CASE(setting_a_key_again_keeps_its_place), TEST_CASE(a_thousand_keys_keep_their_order_through_every_growth), TEST_CASE(a_removal_keeps_the_others_order_and_finds_them_after), TEST_CASE(removing_every_key_leaves_an_empty_map_that_takes_keys_again), TEST_CASE(a_refused_put_leaves_the_map_as_it_was) )
